title: The Psalm 83 war: Israel's neighbours confederate to wipe it out
summary: Asaph's prayer names a confederacy of Israel's bordering enemies (Edom, Ishmaelites, Moab, Hagarenes, Gebal, Ammon, Amalek, Philistia, Tyre and Assyria) who say "let us cut them off from being a nation" (v.4). Bill Salus and Chuck Missler see it as a future war Israel wins just before Ezekiel 38's Gog-Magog invasion, whose list of nations does not include the inner ring. Ken Johnson counts Psalm 83 as fulfilled in the 2006 Lebanon war (#359); this entry keeps it as yet future, possibly 2027.

sources.name: Chuck Missler, The Magog Invasion: An Alternative View (Koinonia House)
Bill Salus, Psalm 83: The Missing Prophecy Revealed
